title: Here’s Why It Could Take Days for Flights to Return to Normal
partialText: With hundreds of planes out of position and crews out of hours, restarting the nation’s flight system is no easy task.

title: Ground Stop Highlights Chronic Vulnerabilities in Air Traffic System
partialText: The Federal Aviation Administration’s aging air traffic control infrastructure has had several disruptive failures in recent months, as officials have sought to make upgrades.

title: Nvidia Scandal Prompts Questions of What It Means to Be a Spy
partialText: U.S. intelligence agencies believe a woman who had an affair with Jensen Huang was a Chinese asset. But there is much more that they are still assessing about her role.

title: What’s Behind the Trump-Huang Relationship?
partialText: President Trump’s show of support for Jensen Huang as he was under fire was a remarkable moment in a relationship that barely existed two years ago. Our White House correspondent Maggie Haberman explains how Mr. Trump came to see Mr. Huang as a modern-day Henry Ford.

title: Tech Leaders Rally Behind Jensen Huang
partialText: In social media posts and letters to Nvidia’s board, Mr. Huang’s billionaire peers described him as a singular leader who could not be replaced at Nvidia.

title: Perhaps the Rumors of Democracy’s Demise Were Premature
partialText: Did the midterm election save it?

title: Alaska Senate Race Between Dan Sullivan and Mary Peltola Still Counting Votes
partialText: The race between Senator Dan S. Sullivan and Ms. Peltola, a former representative, is the only Senate contest that hasn’t been called.

title: Top Democrat Eyes Filibuster-Proof Budget Bill to Unlock Affordability Agenda
partialText: The lawmaker set to lead the House Budget Committee outlined Democrats’ options for forcing a negotiation with President Trump on an economic package to bring down living costs.

title: How the University of North Carolina Tried to Avoid Trump’s Wrath
partialText: The University of North Carolina’s chancellor tried to protect the school from the Trump administration. Work on cancer, suicide, AIDS and coronaviruses was hit anyway.

title: Olivia Wilde Hit Bottom. Here’s How She Bounced Back.
partialText: The actor-director learned a lot about shame, regret and failure — and then made a hit movie.

title: Goodbye, Mr. Chips
partialText: Terrible tech bros leading us into a scary future.

title: ‘Listen’: My Mother Has Dementia. These Sounds Help Bring Her Back.
partialText: In the Alaskan wilderness, a deeper truth awaits those who stop to listen.

title: ‘Get Focused on London’: How Iran’s Agents Attacked European Targets
partialText: A wave of assaults in Britain and elsewhere in the spring sowed fear across Europe. Prosecutors shed new light on how Iran took aim at U.S. allies.
